VENDOR SERVICES AGREEMENT

1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 "Customer Data" means information Customer submits to the Service.

4. TERM AND RENEWAL
4.2 This Agreement automatically renews for successive twenty-four (24) month terms unless Customer provides written notice of non-renewal at least fifteen (15) days before the then-current term ends.

5. DATA PROTECTION AND SECURITY
5.1 Customer Data may be stored, processed, and transferred in any jurisdiction Vendor selects, including the United States, India, and other countries that are not the subject of an adequacy decision.

8. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
8.2 Vendor's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited.

9. TERMINATION
9.1 Customer may not terminate this Agreement for convenience. Termination is permitted solely for material breach that remains uncured for ninety (90) days.
